title: Volunteer teachers’ sit-in outside the Treasury
organizer: Volunteer teachers; named coordination not established in rendered article
threshold_50_evidence: The article says several teachers took part; it does not establish 50 simultaneous participants. The 4,160 figure is the workforce affected, not attendance.

start_date.summary: The opened article dates the sit-in to Thursday morning, 1 October 2020.

location.summary: The report locates the sit-in before the Public Treasury in Brazzaville.

demands.summary: The teachers sought eight months of unpaid remuneration and criticized government treatment.

participants.summary: Only a qualitative description (“several”) is given; 4,160 refers to the total workforce, not the sit-in.

threshold_50.summary: No crowd count or clear lower bound of 50 is established.

notes: Date-specific physical action is retained as a candidate, but attendance threshold remains unknown. A September 17 saucepan protest surfaced in a follow-up search; do not merge without evidence of continuity.
open_questions: Can another contemporary source give a count for this sit-in?
Was there a distinct follow-up action after 1 October?

title: Sopéco workers’ intended demonstration reportedly stopped by police

start_date.summary: The search header/snippet reports workers intended to demonstrate on 6 October; body not opened.

location.summary: Search text identifies the company headquarters in Brazzaville; precise venue not confirmed from body.

demands.summary: Search result associates the action with unpaid salary demands in the wider strike; this relation is not body-verified.

threshold_50.summary: Search-result-only evidence does not establish 50 participants or an actual assembled crowd.

notes: Discovery lead only. Kept separate from the reported strike and from other Sopéco dates; body verification and whether a crowd assembled remain unresolved.
open_questions: Did any workers assemble before police blocked the demonstration?
